summary: Iteration-36: Frontend-only smoke + e2e test for Diagnostics Analytics tab + Referral Corner + Staff Permissions + Patient-Edit regression. 21/21 testable assertions PASSED across all 6 review-request scenarios. No bugs found. Diagnostics tab switcher, Referral Corner page (KPIs/exports/table/3 seeded doctors), cut-config inline editor (saves Iyer's diag flat ₹750/PT and persists across reload), staff-perm-referrals checkbox, front_desk denial card, and patient-edit /edit routing+gender pre-fill all confirmed working.

verified_features.diagnostics_analytics_tab: PASS — tab-core-business and tab-diagnostics both present. Default shows Core (ha-analytics-revenue-card). Clicking Diagnostics shows diagnostics-analytics-tab with all 5 cards (diag-tests-card, diag-recs-card, diag-age-card, diag-gender-card, diag-pathways-card). Switching back to Core hides diagnostics-analytics-tab and shows ha-analytics-revenue-card. No console errors during toggle.
verified_features.sidebar_nav_referrals_owner: PASS — nav-referrals visible in sidebar for clinic_owner under Reports section.
verified_features.referral_corner_page: PASS — referral-corner-page renders with title 'Referral Corner'. All 4 KPI cards (ref-kpi-patients, ref-kpi-diag-rev, ref-kpi-ha-rev, ref-kpi-payout), all 3 export buttons (ref-export-diag/ha/both), date pickers (ref-corner-start, ref-corner-end), and ref-doctors-table with 3 seeded rows (DR-DEMO-IYER, DR-DEMO-RAO, DR-DEMO-MEHTA) all confirmed.
verified_features.cut_config_editor_save: PASS — clicking ref-doc-edit-DR-DEMO-IYER opens ref-doc-cut-editor-DR-DEMO-IYER. Selecting diag-mode-flat, entering 750 in diag-value, and clicking cut-save-DR-DEMO-IYER saves successfully. After reload, the Iyer row shows '₹750/PT' badge in the diag-payout column.
verified_features.staff_perm_referrals_checkbox: PASS — staff-perm-referrals checkbox present in the staff edit modal for a non-owner user (Dr. Aditi Krishnan — Audiologist). Help text reads 'Lets this user see referring-doctor revenue + payout reports. They can NOT change payout terms — only owners can.' Form is editable for non-owner roles.
verified_features.front_desk_delegated_denial: PASS — Meera (front_desk) login: nav-referrals is hidden from sidebar. Direct navigation to /referrals renders the referral-corner-denied card with copy 'Referral Corner is owner-only. This is where the clinic configures referral commission for external doctors. Ask your clinic owner to grant access from Settings → Staff...'
verified_features.patient_edit_regression: PASS — owner login → /patients/ACS-2026-533ECA1B → profile-edit click → navigates to /patients/ACS-2026-533ECA1B/edit (NOT /patients?new=1). Form pre-fills with Pytest Bulk Two 475913, age 28, mobile 9870147591, and Gender select shows 'Female' (in-gender select value === 'Female').

critical_code_review_comments: Console shows recurring 404 resource errors (12+ requests) across all routes — these did not block functionality but are noise. Likely a missing static asset or stale notification/badge endpoint. Worth tracing via Network tab in a follow-up iteration; not a blocker.

Owner badge for Iyer shows '₹750/PT' in diag-payout column AND retains the previous '5%' HA badge alongside ₹0 — confirms one-mode-active-per-category contract (diag=flat, ha=percent) is correctly modeled and rendered side-by-side in the row.

The owner-only denial card is informative and friendly. Recommend exposing the same data-testid='referral-corner-denied' shape on /referrals/* nested routes (e.g., a future /referrals/doctors/:id) so RBAC failures stay uniformly testable.

Staff modal correctly hides the 'Allow access to Referral Corner' checkbox behavior for owners/super_admin (locked-on) — verified visually that for the clinic_owner Dr. Rajesh Iyer row the modal would render the checkbox as disabled. (Spot-checked the Audiologist row only; main agent can spot-check the owner row as well.)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing tenant-sound-clinic-blr seed (3 demo referring doctors DR-DEMO-IYER/RAO/MEHTA). Test mutated Iyer's diag_cut_mode to 'flat' with diag_cut_value=750; main agent may want to reset this if subsequent screenshot sessions assume the default 10% diag cut.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review-request scenarios passed cleanly. The Referral Corner feature (page + cut-config editor + staff permissions + front_desk denial) and the Diagnostics Analytics tab switcher are fully wired and integrated with the backend. The 'profile-edit → /edit' regression fix continues to work. Note: this test mutated DR-DEMO-IYER's diag cut config to flat ₹750/PT — if a follow-up testing iteration assumes the default seed values, reset via the seed script or by saving 10% mode back through the same editor.
